component.name: Ensemble
component.summary: Offline typewriter and custom work skin composer for Archive of Our Own

description.p: Ensemble is a dedicated desktop writing environment designed for authors writing for Archive of Our Own (AO3). It features real-time AO3 HTML simulation, live CSS Work Skin editing, automated HTML sanitization conforming to AO3 whitelists, and an embedded Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agent collaboration.
